result: Dataset prepared; evaluation results belong to the linked reader experiments.
note: Derived by retaining sources whose hand-authored important label is true, copying their text into writes.json, and copying reads.json unchanged. 26 writes, 48 known questions, eight unknown questions. This gives oracle selection, not learned importance detection. Evaluated by activation-memory-natural-write-v1 and activation-memory-natural-read-v1.
